channel.title: Executive Remuneration
channel.description: Commentary by Edward Brown KC on new cases, legislation and regulation affecting executive pay. A companion to Executive Remuneration: Law and Practice (OUP, forthcoming).

item.title: Fire and rehire: cash protected, shares not
item.description: From March 2027, dismissing an employee for refusing a reduction in contractual cash pay will generally be automatically unfair. The Government has confirmed that changes to share schemes will fall outside the protection. But for executive remuneration, the more important dividing line may be between contractual entitlements and separate plan arrangements.

item.title: Shorter deferral, unchanged clawback
item.description: The 2025 reforms cut minimum deferral for material risk takers in dual-regulated firms to four years. The seven-year clawback period did not move, so more of it now falls after pay has vested.

item.title: Non-financial misconduct and pay
item.description: Since 1 September 2026 the conduct rules reach serious bullying, harassment and violence in firms other than banks. The rules say nothing about pay, but they widen the conduct capable of engaging malus and clawback.
